    /* SNOW */
    .snowflake {
      position: absolute;
      top: -8%;
      width: 6px;
      height: 6px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.95);
      box-shadow: 0 0 6px rgba(255,255,255,0.8);
      animation: snowFall linear infinite;
      opacity: 0.9;
    }
    .snowflake.big {
      width: 9px;
      height: 9px;
      opacity: 0.75;
    }
    .frost {
      position: absolute;
      inset: auto 0 0 0;
      height: 34%;
      background:
        linear-gradient(180deg, transparent, rgba(255,255,255,0.22)),
        radial-gradient(ellipse at 20% 100%, rgba(255,255,255,0.35), transparent 50%),
        radial-gradient(ellipse at 80% 100%, rgba(255,255,255,0.28), transparent 45%);
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    /* Detail sheet (expands info on selection) */
    .sheet {
      position: fixed;
      left: 50%;
      bottom: calc(18px + var(--safe-bottom));
      transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(120%);
      width: min(720px, calc(100vw - 40px));
      z-index: 20;
      border-radius: 22px;
      padding: 14px 16px;
      background: rgba(20, 24, 32, 0.55);
      border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.16);
      backdrop-filter: blur(28px) saturate(170%);
      -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(28px) saturate(170%);
      box-shadow: 0 20px 50px rgba(0,0,0,0.35);
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1.2fr 1fr 1fr 1fr;
      gap: 10px;
      opacity: 0;
      pointer-events: none;
      transition: transform 480ms var(--spring), opacity 320ms ease;
    }
    .sheet.open {
      transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(0);
      opacity: 1;
      pointer-events: auto;
    }
    .sheet .s-title {
      grid-column: 1 / -1;
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: center;
      margin-bottom: 2px;
    }
    .sheet .s-title strong {
      font-size: 14px;
      font-weight: 650;
      letter-spacing: -0.02em;
    }
    .sheet .s-title span {
      font-size: 12px;
      color: var(--text-tertiary);
    }
    .sheet .cell {
      border-radius: 14px;
      padding: 10px 12px;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.08);
      border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08);
    }
    .sheet .cell .k {
      font-size: 10px;
      font-weight: 700;
      letter-spacing: 0.06em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: var(--text-tertiary);
      margin-bottom: 4px;
    }
    .sheet .cell .v {
      font-size: 15px;
      font-weight: 600;
      letter-spacing: -0.02em;
      font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
    }
    .sheet .close {
      border: none;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
      color: #fff;
      width: 28px;
      height: 28px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      cursor: pointer;
      font-size: 14px;
      line-height: 1;
    }

    /* Keyframes */
    @keyframes sunPulse {
      0%, 100% { transform: scale(1); filter: brightness(1); }
      50% { transform: scale(1.06); filter: brightness(1.08); }
    }
    @keyframes sunSpin { to { transform: rotate(360deg); } }
    @keyframes cloudDrift {
      0%, 100% { transform: translateX(0); }
      50% { transform: translateX(18px); }
    }
    @keyframes windMove {
      0% { transform: translateX(0); opacity: 0; }
      15% { opacity: 0.6; }
      85% { opacity: 0.35; }
      100% { transform: translateX(160%); opacity: 0; }
    }
    @keyframes leafFly {
      0% { transform: translate(-20%, 0) rotate(0deg); opacity: 0; }
      10% { opacity: 0.85; }
      100% { transform: translate(140vw, 40px) rotate(360deg); opacity: 0; }
    }
    @keyframes rainFall {
      0% { transform: translateY(0) translateX(0); opacity: 0; }
      10% { opacity: 0.8; }
      100% { transform: translateY(120vh) translateX(-18px); opacity: 0.15; }
    }
    @keyframes lightning {
      0%, 88%, 100% { opacity: 0; }
      90% { opacity: 0.75; }
      92% { opacity: 0.1; }
      94% { opacity: 0.85; }
      96% { opacity: 0; }
    }
    @keyframes stormBob {
      0%, 100% { transform: translateY(0); }
      50% { transform: translateY(6px); }
    }
    @keyframes snowFall {
      0% { transform: translateY(0) translateX(0); opacity: 0; }
      10% { opacity: 0.95; }
      100% { transform: translateY(120vh) translateX(24px); opacity: 0.2; }
    }
    @keyframes livePulse {
      0%, 100% { transform: scale(1); opacity: 1; }
      50% { transform: scale(0.85); opacity: 0.7; }
    }
    @keyframes cardIn {
      from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(18px) scale(0.97); }
      to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0) scale(1); }
    }
    .card {
      animation: cardIn 700ms var(--spring) both;
    }
    .card:nth-child(1) { animation-delay: 40ms; }
    .card:nth-child(2) { animation-delay: 120ms; }
    .card:nth-child(3) { animation-delay: 200ms; }
    .card:nth-child(4) { animation-delay: 280ms; }


    body.sheet-open .rail-wrap {
      padding-bottom: 96px;
    }
    @media (max-height: 560px) {
      body.sheet-open .rail-wrap { padding-bottom: 88px; }
      .sheet { padding: 10px 12px; }
    }

    /* Reduced motion */
    @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
      *, *::before, *::after {
        animation-duration: 0.01ms !important;
        animation-iteration-count: 1 !important;
        transition-duration: 0.01ms !important;
      }
    }

    /* Narrow / portrait fallback: horizontal scroll rail */
    @media (max-width: 980px), (orientation: portrait) {
      body { overflow: auto; }
      .app { min-height: 100dvh; height: auto; }
      .rail-wrap { flex: none; height: min(68vh, 520px); }
      .rail {
        display: flex;
        overflow-x: auto;
        overflow-y: hidden;
        scroll-snap-type: x mandatory;
        scroll-padding: 12px;
        gap: 12px;
        padding-bottom: 6px;
        -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;
      }
      .card {
        flex: 0 0 min(78vw, 320px);
        scroll-snap-align: center;
        min-height: 100%;
      }
      .sheet {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
        width: calc(100vw - 24px);
      }
    }

    @media (min-width: 981px) and (max-height: 520px) {
      .metrics { margin-top: 8px; }
      .temp { font-size: clamp(40px, 9vh, 64px); }
      .content { padding: 14px 16px; }
    }
  </style>
</head>
<body>
  <div class="app-bg" id="appBg" aria-hidden="true"></div>

  <div class="app">
    <header class="topbar">
      <div class="brand">
        <div class="eyebrow">Weather</div>
        <h1>今日天气</h1>
      </div>
      <div class="top-actions">
        <button class="pill" id="btnLive" type="button" title="实时更新">
          <span class="dot" aria-hidden="true"></span>
          实时
        </button>
        <button class="pill" id="btnShuffle" type="button" title="随机城市">随机</button>
        <button class="pill" id="btnPlay" type="button" title="动画" aria-pressed="true">暂停动画</button>
      </div>
    </header>

    <div class="rail-wrap">
      <div class="rail" id="rail" role="listbox" aria-label="天气卡片">
        <!-- cards injected -->
      </div>
    </div>

    <footer class="dock">
      <div class="page-dots" id="dots" aria-label="卡片指示"></div>
      <div class="footnote" id="footnote">轻点卡片查看详情 · 支持键盘 ← →</div>
    </footer>
  </div>

  <aside class="sheet" id="sheet" aria-live="polite" hidden>
    <div class="s-title">
      <strong id="sheetTitle">详情</strong>
      <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;">
        <span id="sheetSub">iOS 18</span>
        <button class="close" id="sheetClose" type="button" aria-label="关闭">✕</button>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="cell"><div class="k">体感</div><div class="v" id="sFeels">—</div></div>
    <div class="cell"><div class="k">湿度</div><div class="v" id="sHumidity">—</div></div>
    <div class="cell"><div class="k">风速</div><div class="v" id="sWind">—</div></div>
    <div class="cell"><div class="k">紫外线</div><div class="v" id="sUV">—</div></div>
  </aside>

  <script>
    const DATA = [
      {
        id: 'sunny',
        city: '三亚',
        region: '海南',
        condition: '晴朗',
        temp: 31,
        high: 33,
        low: 26,
        feels: 34,
        humidity: 58,
        wind: '东南 8 km/h',
        uv: '很强 · 9',
        aqi: '优 32',
        visibility: '24 km',
        badge: '适宜出行',
        bg: 'linear-gradient(160deg, #1a4f8a 0%, #2f6f9e 40%, #c4a35a 100%)',
      },
      {
        id: 'windy',
        city: '厦门',
        region: '福建',
        condition: '大风',
        temp: 22,
        high: 24,
        low: 18,
        feels: 19,
        humidity: 64,
        wind: '东北 42 km/h',
        uv: '中等 · 4',
        aqi: '良 68',
        visibility: '16 km',
        badge: '注意防风',
        bg: 'linear-gradient(160deg, #3d5266 0%, #6b8499 55%, #9eb4c6 100%)',
      },
      {
        id: 'storm',
        city: '广州',
        region: '广东',
        condition: '暴雨',
        temp: 24,
        high: 26,
        low: 22,
        feels: 27,
        humidity: 94,
        wind: '南风 28 km/h',
        uv: '弱 · 1',
        aqi: '优 41',
        visibility: '3 km',
        badge: '强对流',
        bg: 'linear-gradient(165deg, #0d1424 0%, #1c2a48 50%, #141c30 100%)',
      },
      {
        id: 'snow',
        city: '哈尔滨',
        region: '黑龙江',
        condition: '暴雪',
        temp: -12,
        high: -8,
        low: -18,
        feels: -19,
        humidity: 79,
        wind: '北风 24 km/h',
        uv: '低 · 0',
        aqi: '优 28',
        visibility: '0.8 km',
        badge: '道路结冰',
        bg: 'linear-gradient(165deg, #3f6f9a 0%, #7fafd6 50%, #d5e8f6 100%)',
      },
    ];

    const rail = document.getElementById('rail');
    const dots = document.getElementById('dots');
    const appBg = document.getElementById('appBg');
    const sheet = document.getElementById('sheet');
    const footnote = document.getElementById('footnote');
    let activeId = 'sunny';
    let animOn = true;
    let clockTimers = [];

    function iconFor(id) {
      const icons = {
        sunny: '<svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="none"><circle cx="8" cy="8" r="3" fill="currentColor"/><path d="M8 1.5v1.5M8 13v1.5M1.5 8H3M13 8h1.5M3.2 3.2l1.1 1.1M11.7 11.7l1.1 1.1M12.8 3.2l-1.1 1.1M4.3 11.7l-1.1 1.1" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.4" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg>',
        windy: '<svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="none"><path d="M2 6h8a2 2 0 1 0-2-2M2 9h10a2.2 2.2 0 1 1-2 2M2 12h6" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg>',
        storm: '<svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="none"><path d="M5 3.5h5a3 3 0 0 1 .2 6H5.2A2.6 2.6 0 0 1 5 3.5z" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.4"/><path d="M7 10.5 5.5 13h2L6 15" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.4" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/></svg>',
        snow: '<svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="none"><path d="M8 2v12M3.5 4.5l9 7M12.5 4.5l-9 7" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.4" stroke-linecap="round"/><circle cx="8" cy="8" r="1.3" fill="currentColor"/></svg>',
      };
      return icons[id] || '';
    }

    function stageHTML(id) {
      if (id === 'sunny') {
        return `
          <div class="sun"></div>
          <div class="sun-ray"></div>
          <div class="cloud-soft c1"></div>
          <div class="cloud-soft c2"></div>`;
      }
      if (id === 'windy') {
        return `
          <div class="wind-line"></div><div class="wind-line"></div><div class="wind-line"></div>
          <div class="wind-line"></div><div class="wind-line"></div>
          <div class="leaf"></div><div class="leaf"></div><div class="leaf"></div>`;
      }
      if (id === 'storm') {
        let drops = '';
        for (let i = 0; i < 28; i++) {
          const left = (i * 3.5 + (i % 5)) % 100;
          const delay = (i * 0.13) % 1.8;
          const dur = 0.55 + (i % 5) * 0.12;
          const h = 10 + (i % 4) * 3;
          drops += `<div class="raindrop" style="left:${left}%;animation-delay:-${delay}s;animation-duration:${dur}s;height:${h}px;"></div>`;
        }
        return `<div class="storm-cloud"></div><div class="flash"></div>${drops}`;
      }
      if (id === 'snow') {
        let flakes = '';
        for (let i = 0; i < 26; i++) {
          const left = (i * 3.9 + (i % 7) * 2) % 100;
          const delay = (i * 0.27) % 5;
          const dur = 3.8 + (i % 6) * 0.55;
          const big = i % 4 === 0 ? ' big' : '';
          flakes += `<div class="snowflake${big}" style="left:${left}%;animation-delay:-${delay}s;animation-duration:${dur}s;"></div>`;
        }
        return `${flakes}<div class="frost"></div>`;
      }
      return '';
    }

    function formatTemp(n) {
      return `${n}<span>°</span>`;
    }

    function nowTime() {
      return new Date().toLocaleTimeString('zh-CN', { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' });
    }

    function build() {
      rail.innerHTML = '';
      dots.innerHTML = '';
      DATA.forEach((d, i) => {
        const card = document.createElement('article');
        card.className = 'card';
        card.dataset.weather = d.id;
        card.dataset.id = d.id;
        card.setAttribute('role', 'option');
        card.setAttribute('tabindex', '0');
        card.setAttribute('aria-selected', d.id === activeId ? 'true' : 'false');
        card.innerHTML = `
          <div class="card-bg"></div>
          <div class="stage">${stageHTML(d.id)}</div>
          <div class="content">
            <div class="card-head">
              <div class="loc">
                <div class="city">${d.city}</div>
                <div class="time" data-clock>${d.region} · ${nowTime()}</div>
              </div>
              <div class="badge">${iconFor(d.id)}${d.badge}</div>
            </div>
            <div class="hero">
              <div class="temp">${formatTemp(d.temp)}</div>
              <div class="condition">${d.condition}</div>
              <div class="hi-lo">最高 ${d.high}° · 最低 ${d.low}°</div>
              <div class="metrics">
                <div class="metric"><div class="label">风力</div><div class="value">${d.wind.replace(' ', ' · ')}</div></div>
                <div class="metric"><div class="label">湿度</div><div class="value">${d.humidity}%</div></div>
                <div class="metric"><div class="label">体感</div><div class="value">${d.feels}°</div></div>
                <div class="metric"><div class="label">空气</div><div class="value">${d.aqi}</div></div>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>`;
        card.addEventListener('click', () => select(d.id, true));
        card.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
          if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') {
            e.preventDefault();
            select(d.id, true);
          }
        });
        rail.appendChild(card);

        const dot = document.createElement('button');
        dot.type = 'button';
        dot.setAttribute('aria-label', d.condition);
        if (d.id === activeId) dot.setAttribute('aria-current', 'true');
        dot.addEventListener('click', () => select(d.id, true));
        dots.appendChild(dot);
      });
      applySelection(false);
      startClocks();
    }

    function select(id, openSheet) {
      const same = id === activeId;
      activeId = id;
      applySelection(true);
      if (!openSheet) return;
      if (same && sheet.classList.contains('open')) hideSheet();
      else showSheet(id);
    }

    function applySelection(animateBg) {
      const cards = [...rail.querySelectorAll('.card')];
      cards.forEach((c) => {
        const on = c.dataset.id === activeId;
        c.classList.toggle('is-active', on);
        c.classList.toggle('is-dimmed', !on);
        c.setAttribute('aria-selected', on ? 'true' : 'false');
      });
      [...dots.children].forEach((d, i) => {
        if (DATA[i].id === activeId) d.setAttribute('aria-current', 'true');
        else d.removeAttribute('aria-current');
      });
      const data = DATA.find((d) => d.id === activeId);
      if (data) {
        appBg.style.transition = animateBg ? 'background 700ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1)' : 'none';
        appBg.style.background = `${data.bg}`;
      }
    }

    function showSheet(id) {
      const d = DATA.find((x) => x.id === id);
      if (!d) return;
      sheet.hidden = false;
      document.getElementById('sheetTitle').textContent = `${d.city} · ${d.condition}`;
      document.getElementById('sheetSub').textContent = `${d.region} · 能见度 ${d.visibility}`;
      document.getElementById('sFeels').textContent = `${d.feels}°`;
      document.getElementById('sHumidity').textContent = `${d.humidity}%`;
      document.getElementById('sWind').textContent = d.wind;
      document.getElementById('sUV').textContent = d.uv;
      document.body.classList.add('sheet-open');
      requestAnimationFrame(() => sheet.classList.add('open'));
      footnote.textContent = '再次轻点可切换城市 · Esc 关闭详情';
    }

    function hideSheet() {
      sheet.classList.remove('open');
      document.body.classList.remove('sheet-open');
      setTimeout(() => { sheet.hidden = true; }, 320);
      footnote.textContent = '轻点卡片查看详情 · 支持键盘 ← →';
    }

    document.getElementById('sheetClose').addEventListener('click', hideSheet);
    sheet.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
      if (e.target === sheet) hideSheet();
    });

    document.getElementById('btnPlay').addEventListener('click', () => {
      animOn = !animOn;
      document.querySelectorAll('.stage').forEach((s) => {
        s.style.animationPlayState = animOn ? 'running' : 'paused';
        s.querySelectorAll('*').forEach((el) => {
          el.style.animationPlayState = animOn ? 'running' : 'paused';
        });
      });
      const playBtn = document.getElementById('btnPlay');
      playBtn.textContent = animOn ? '暂停动画' : '播放动画';
      playBtn.setAttribute('aria-pressed', animOn ? 'true' : 'false');
    });

    document.getElementById('btnLive').addEventListener('click', () => {
      // subtle live refresh: nudge temps by 0 and re-time
      document.querySelectorAll('[data-clock]').forEach((el, i) => {
        const d = DATA[i];
        el.textContent = `${d.region} · ${nowTime()}`;
      });
      const btn = document.getElementById('btnLive');
      btn.animate(
        [{ transform: 'scale(1)' }, { transform: 'scale(0.96)' }, { transform: 'scale(1)' }],
        { duration: 280, easing: 'cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1)' }
      );
      footnote.textContent = `已更新 · ${nowTime()}`;
    });

    document.getElementById('btnShuffle').addEventListener('click', () => {
      const cities = {
        sunny: ['三亚', '丽江', '敦煌', '西双版纳'],
        windy: ['厦门', '大连', '青岛', '北海'],
        storm: ['广州', '深圳', '南宁', '海口'],
        snow: ['哈尔滨', '长春', '呼伦贝尔', '阿勒泰'],
      };
      DATA.forEach((d) => {
        const list = cities[d.id];
        d.city = list[Math.floor(Math.random() * list.length)];
      });
      const keep = activeId;
      build();
      activeId = keep;
      applySelection(false);
    });

    // keyboard navigation
    window.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
      const idx = DATA.findIndex((d) => d.id === activeId);
      if (e.key === 'ArrowRight' || e.key === 'ArrowDown') {
        e.preventDefault();
        select(DATA[(idx + 1) % DATA.length].id, sheet.classList.contains('open'));
      } else if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft' || e.key === 'ArrowUp') {
        e.preventDefault();
        select(DATA[(idx - 1 + DATA.length) % DATA.length].id, sheet.classList.contains('open'));
      } else if (e.key === 'Escape') {
        hideSheet();
      }
    });

    // pointer parallax on active card
    rail.addEventListener('pointermove', (e) => {
      const card = e.target.closest('.card');
      if (!card || !card.classList.contains('is-active')) return;
      const r = card.getBoundingClientRect();
      const x = (e.clientX - r.left) / r.width - 0.5;
      const y = (e.clientY - r.top) / r.height - 0.5;
      const stage = card.querySelector('.stage');
      if (stage) {
        stage.style.transform = `translate(${x * 10}px, ${y * 8}px)`;
      }
    });
    rail.addEventListener('pointerleave', () => {
      rail.querySelectorAll('.stage').forEach((s) => { s.style.transform = ''; });
    });

    function startClocks() {
      clockTimers.forEach(clearInterval);
      clockTimers = [];
      const tick = () => {
        document.querySelectorAll('[data-clock]').forEach((el, i) => {
          const d = DATA[i];
          if (d) el.textContent = `${d.region} · ${nowTime()}`;
        });
      };
      clockTimers.push(setInterval(tick, 30000));
    }

    // init
    build();

    // respect reduced motion
    if (window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches) {
      animOn = false;
      const playBtn = document.getElementById('btnPlay');
      playBtn.textContent = '播放动画';
      playBtn.setAttribute('aria-pressed', 'false');
    }
  </script>
</body>
